title: Operator Today — Pack 3
notes: Replace the operator's dashboard-style home with a task-first Today screen centered on the active or next assigned job.
Show job number, title, shop time, on-site time, location, client, assigned unit and privacy-safe crew count directly on Today.
Surface the next real workflow action on the main screen: Acknowledge dispatch, Start driving, Mark on site, Start work or Complete job.
Reuse Northborn's existing secured dispatch and completion actions instead of creating a second status workflow.
Add one-tap job actions for Directions, Dispatch call, Safety, Field Ticket and Time.
Show simple Later Today or Next Scheduled rows instead of dashboard KPI cards.
Remove the legacy operator-only mobile navigation bar so Pack 2's role-aware bottom navigation is the single phone navigation system.
Keep coworker employee details private: operators see assigned crew count/roles without gaining access to other employee profiles.
Add browser regression coverage for the active job, status action, field quick actions and removal of duplicate mobile navigation.
